name: Titaanium Ten Enterprise Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Titaanium Ten Enterprise is a manufacturer and supplier of synthetic yarns and fabrics[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company does trading of yarn, grey cloth and knitted fabrics and also manufactures knitted fabrics. It undertakes job work of yarn and fabrics. Company has also started working on Furnishing and Home Decor Products, Handling Local Dispatches and Logistics Business

pros: Debtor days have improved from 52.1 to 31.6 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -5.64% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 12.2% over last 3 years.
